name: Giraffe
intro: A giraffe is the tallest animal in the world. It has a very long neck.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A giraffe is the tallest animal on land.
Its neck is about as long as a grown-up is tall.
It has brown spots on its coat.
No two giraffes have the same spots.
It has two hairy horns called ossicones.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Giraffes live in Africa.
They live on grassy savannas.
They like places with acacia trees.
Some live in open woodlands.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Giraffes are herbivores, so they eat only plants.
They eat leaves from tall trees.
Acacia leaves are a favorite food.
Their long tongues help them grab leaves.
To drink, they spread their front legs wide.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby giraffe is called a calf.
A new calf is already taller than a grown-up.
A calf can run just hours after it is born.
Mom hides her calf in tall grass.
The calf stays with mom for about 2 years.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Giraffes have 7 neck bones, just like you.
A giraffe can run as fast as a car on a town street.
Giraffes sleep only a few hours a day.
Other animals stay near giraffes to watch for danger.
Boy giraffes play-fight with their horns.
